title: New Mumbai
sideASummary: Player deck back. No printed text. State 2 and state 4 side A are the same back. State 3 side A is a blank black image, not the player back.
sideBSummary: New Mumbai, 19°2'43"N 72°50'55"E, code P2-15b. The compass carries an anchor, so the city is a port. Two sealed boxes, labeled SEARCH THE LAND: and SEARCH THE SEA:. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: Gain 1 action. A Hollow Man by the water was drawing a family, mother and children, the father drawn as himself, and was crying. The searchers kept their distance. Immediate. No companion. Also visible when both boxes are open in state 4.
A lost haven has been found and not yet reached. Open door 65 and add it to the board. If 65 is already open, gain 1 action. Also visible when both boxes are open in state 4.

states.summary: Land box only. A Hollow Man near the water was sketching a family and crying; the searchers kept their distance. Gain 1 action. The sea box stays sealed. Side A is the player back.

Sea box only. A lost haven is found but not yet accessed. Open 65 and add it to the board. If 65 is already open, gain 1 action. The land box stays sealed. Side A of this state is a blank black file, about 5 KB, not the player back.
Both boxes open: land gives 1 action, and the sea opens door 65 or gives 1 action if 65 is already open. Side A is the player back. Code P2-15b is unchanged.

rules: Black Player card for New Mumbai. Port, marked by the anchor.
Two scratch boxes. State 2 reveals land only, state 3 sea only, state 4 both.
Land: gain 1 action. Not a companion.
Sea: open door 65 and add it to the board. If 65 is already open, gain 1 action instead.
notes: Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
Door 65 is not in this package. The sea text says to open it and add it to the board.
The scratch panels fill the center. No bullseye upgrade mark is printed.
